```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h = len(grid); w = len(grid[0])
    flat = Counter(c for row in grid for c in row)
    bg = flat.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: color forming a full column
    line_col = None
    for j in range(w):
        col = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and col[0] != bg:
            line_col = j; line_color = col[0]
    cells = [(i, j, grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
             if grid[i][j] not in (bg, line_color)]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    minc = min(j for _, j, _ in cells)
    maxc = max(j for _, j, _ in cells)
    width = maxc - minc + 1
    shift = (line_col + 1) - minc
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        out[i][line_col] = line_color
    for i, j, v in cells:
        out[i][j + shift] = v
    eight_col = line_col + 1 + width
    if 0 <= eight_col < w:
        for i in range(h):
            out[i][eight_col] = 8
    return out
```
